note.question: How should investment and application be designed?
note.overview: Phase III clinical trials are expensive and require enrolling and treating hundreds or thousands of patients at many sites. The time and cost required to do so are uncertain, as is the economic value of the drug upon completion. The model considers the problem of determining when and how many test sites should be opened and the rate at which patients should be recruited.
